thesis: PGNY is in a clean uptrend (close above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200) after a post-earnings gap that held, and it is now digesting on average volume, which gives a defined pullback entry. Fundamentals are high quality and accelerating, with net income growing much faster than revenue, positive free cash flow, cash well above debt and low dilution risk. Its forward P/E is far below its trailing P/E, and the Zacks Rank #1 upgrade on rising estimate revisions supports further momentum. The case is limited by a risk-off regime, a target that is only the 52-week high, and a tight stop, so this is a modest, tactical long, not a high-conviction one.
